name: Ripppple
description: Cascading LFO chain, each stage modulates the next

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — root LFO speed on channel 0; modulation depth on channels 1–3
Alt (Shift) — morph of the root wave on channel 0; base rate of the stage on channels 1–3
Third (own button held) — skew of the root wave on channel 0; morph of the stage on channels 1–2
Channel 3 Third — symmetry, shared by every stage instead of a private morph

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Channel 0 short — freeze the root value; the whole chain stops moving
Channel 0 Shift + short — clock sync for the root, available only while the internal LFO runs
Channels 1–3 short — mute/unmute that stage; a fader scrub while the button is held cancels the tap
Channels 1–3 long — cycle the modulation target through Rate → Depth → Shape; the channel hue follows and the button LED flashes
The same three targets are also the params Target B, Target C and Target D in the configurator — the param sets the start value, a long press changes it live and pushes the new name back
Channels 1–3 Shift + long — cycle the output range of that stage (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V); the button flashes 1× for ±5 V, 2× for 0–10 V; stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows

sections.heading: Signal / LEDs
items: Channel 0 is the root: a CV input that falls back to an internal LFO when the jack has been static for about a second
Channel 1 is modulated by the root, channel 2 by the output of channel 1, channel 3 by the output of channel 2
Every stage sees only its direct predecessor, so the chain diverges further towards the back
Rate bends the tempo of the stage exponentially, roughly ±3 octaves
Depth is amplitude modulation — the stage ducks towards silence as its predecessor swings negative
Shape pushes the wave of the stage along the morph axis
LFO Speed shifts the root range to Slow or Slowest
Top and bottom LEDs are a bipolar meter of the stage output
The hue of channels 1–3 encodes the active modulation target; channel 0 changes hue depending on whether the CV input or the internal LFO drives it
Button LEDs on channels 1–3 breathe with the stage output even while Shift is held, so the Alt-layer rate stays visible
Muted channels are heavily dimmed and their button LED goes dark
All four channels can mirror their level as MIDI CC or NRPN, using the base CC plus the channel offset

channels.jackDescription: Root input. Set In Range to 0–10 V for unipolar sources or ±5 V for bipolar ones. Jack movement switches to CV in; after about a second of a static signal the internal LFO takes over.
channels.faderDescription: Rate of the internal root LFO, or its clock division when sync is on.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Morphs the root wave from ramp through triangle, sine and square into chaos.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Skews the root wave towards rising or falling.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap holds the root value — the value itself, not just the phase, so stepped morph nodes hold too. The whole chain freezes with it.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: While the internal LFO runs, toggles between free-running and clock-synced. The button flashes when sync engages; a stopped transport parks the wave.
channels.ledTop: Root level in the source hue — one hue for CV in, another while the internal LFO runs
channels.ledBottom: Root level in the source hue — one hue for CV in, another while the internal LFO runs

channels.jackDescription: First stage of the chain, modulated by the root. Range B sets 0–10 V or ±5 V, Target B picks Rate, Depth or Shape.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly the root drives the modulation target of this stage. At zero the stage free-runs.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Free-running rate of this stage before any rate modulation.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Wave of this stage, from ramp through triangle, sine and square into chaos.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output with a click-free ramp. A long press cycles the modulation target through Rate → Depth → Shape; the channel hue follows and the button flashes. The same choice is the param “Target B” in the configurator.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long press cycles the output range (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V). The button flashes once for ±5 V and twice for 0–10 V. The range is stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows.
channels.ledTop: Bipolar meter of the stage output, hued by the active modulation target
channels.ledBottom: Bipolar meter of the stage output, hued by the active modulation target

channels.jackDescription: Second stage, modulated by the output of channel 1. Range C sets 0–10 V or ±5 V, Target C picks Rate, Depth or Shape.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly the previous stage drives the modulation target of this stage.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Free-running rate of this stage before any rate modulation.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Wave of this stage, from ramp through triangle, sine and square into chaos.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output. A long press cycles the modulation target through Rate → Depth → Shape.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long press cycles the output range (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V). The button flashes once for ±5 V and twice for 0–10 V. The range is stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows.
channels.ledTop: Bipolar meter of the stage output, hued by the active modulation target
channels.ledBottom: Bipolar meter of the stage output, hued by the active modulation target

channels.jackDescription: Third and last stage, modulated by the output of channel 2. Range D sets 0–10 V or ±5 V, Target D picks Rate, Depth or Shape.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly the previous stage drives the modulation target of this stage.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Free-running rate of this stage before any rate modulation.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Shared by every stage: bends the wave symmetry of the whole chain. This channel trades its private morph for it.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output. A long press cycles the modulation target through Rate → Depth → Shape.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long press cycles the output range (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V). The button flashes once for ±5 V and twice for 0–10 V. The range is stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows.
channels.ledTop: Bipolar meter of the stage output, hued by the active modulation target
